changelog: Improves homepage artwork performance and cleanup. Recently viewed artwork is reused from a small account-scoped cache, superseded image requests are cancelled, and unused fading images are released promptly. Background and logo requests run together. Hidden pages stop layout polling; leaving the page clears artwork and timers, and returning restores one hero. Preserves the mobile homepage layout, native controls, settings, identity, and normal plugin updates.
description: A unified cinematic Jellyfin Web customization with a profile-forward login screen, Plex-inspired theme, and rotating library-driven home hero.
name: Cinematic UI
overview: Cinematic login and home experience for Jellyfin Web
